scene_summary: A small office-like room with a window blind, cubby shelf, floor lamp, two gray chairs, a dark door, a foreground desk and a plant.
overall_evidence: The reconstruction captures the main objects and their broad arrangement, including the window over the shelf, lamp to the left, door to the right and plant in the foreground. Fidelity is reduced by a noticeably different viewpoint and framing, simplified or missing visible chair and door details, and the loss of the reference's wood floor texture and stronger material contrast.

main_defects.description: The viewpoint is higher and framed more widely toward the left; the desk occupies a lower, narrower foreground area, and the door and furniture appear smaller relative to the image.
main_defects.evidence: The reference door spans much of the image height and the desk fills the lower left, whereas the reconstruction door is substantially shorter in frame and the desk is mostly cropped along the bottom.
main_defects.uncertainty: Differences in actual object size or placement may also contribute to the apparent framing change.

main_defects.description: The right chair's wheeled base is not visible in the reconstruction, and the door has fewer visible inset panels than the reference.
main_defects.evidence: The reference right chair has a prominent black five-spoke caster base; the reconstruction shows its shell but no comparable base. The reference door shows four rows of two panels, while the reconstruction shows three rows of two.
main_defects.uncertainty: The desk or cropping may conceal the reconstructed chair base; its absence from view does not establish that it is missing from the scene.

main_defects.description: The warm, varied wood-plank floor is replaced by a pale, largely uniform tile-like surface; the door and desk also appear lighter and flatter.
main_defects.evidence: The reference floor has pronounced brown grain and irregular plank coloration, while the reconstruction floor has thin grid lines and almost no visible grain.
main_defects.uncertainty: Lighting and exposure may contribute to the apparent color and contrast differences.

main_defects.description: The window and shelf appear narrower and smaller in the reconstruction, while the door is relatively narrow and compact in the image.
main_defects.evidence: The reference blind spans roughly a quarter of the image width and is visually substantial above the shelf; the reconstruction presents a shallower, smaller blind and shelf ensemble, and a much shorter door in frame.
main_defects.uncertainty: Perspective and camera framing are plausible contributors, so these image-space differences do not prove incorrect physical dimensions.

main_defects.description: The reconstruction shows prominent plant blades but not the reference's large turquoise pot and dark soil.
main_defects.evidence: The reference has a conspicuous rounded teal planter across the bottom right, whereas only foliage is visible in the corresponding reconstruction foreground.
main_defects.uncertainty: The planter may exist outside the reconstructed camera frame.

strengths: The major office objects are recognizable and broadly arranged as in the reference.
The pale wooden cubby shelf sits below the horizontal blind, with a slender floor lamp to its left and a white cabinet to its right.
Two gray chair shells, the dark paneled door, foreground desk and spiky plant are represented.
uncertainty: This is a single-view comparison of rendered images, not ground-truth geometry or a human rating. Perspective, cropping, occlusion and lighting can explain some apparent size, placement and visibility differences. The score is an initial automated judgment, not a validated aggregate metric.
